description: Perplexity brand mentions: ask Perplexity a buyer's question and report whether it mentions your brand, which sources it cites, and whether your domain is cited. Costs API credits per call.

brand.description: Brand name to look for in the answer.

domain.description: Optional brand domain to look for among cited sources.

prompt.description: The question a buyer would ask, for example "best seo tools for agencies".

name: check_perplexity_brand_mentions

balanceMicros.description: API credit balance left after the call, in micros.

cacheHit.description: True when served from the 24-hour cache.

chargedMicros.description: Amount charged, in millionths of a US dollar.

creditsNotice.description: Low API credit balance: tell the user once, with this link to add credits. Never open it automatically.

dashboardUrl.description: Dashboard page where this tool also runs in the app; its call history and costs are linked from there. Share it when the user asks what they ran or spent.

domainCited.description: Whether the brand domain is among cited sources; null when no domain was given.

mentioned.description: Whether the answer names the brand or its domain.

title: Perplexity brand mentions
